description: A PHP web page script for managing LAN Ethernet ports, including displaying port status, enabling/disabling port 4 for XFINITY HOME or HOME SECURITY, and handling WAN port configurations for specific partners.

methods.name: getPort4XHSEnabled
methods.description: Determines if port 4 is enabled for XFINITY HOME or HOME SECURITY based on MultiLAN configuration.

methods.name: NameMap
methods.description: Maps Ethernet port status strings to user-friendly labels, considering WAN and Docsis configurations.
